cases.sentence: ___ этот тогда пошел и сказал иудеям, что его исцелил Иисус.
cases.translation: That man then went and told the Jews that Jesus had healed him.
cases.explain: Человек is the grammatical subject of the verb пошёл ("went"), so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Когда я стараюсь сам дойти до ___, кто-нибудь меня уже опережает.
cases.translation: When I try to reach the water myself, someone else gets there before me.
cases.explain: The preposition до ("up to, as far as") always governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Недалеко от овечьих ___, есть пруд, называемый по-еврейски Вефезда.
cases.translation: Not far from the sheep gate there is a pool called Bethesda in Hebrew.
cases.explain: The preposition от ("from, near") governs the genitive case, giving ворот, the genitive plural of the plural-only noun ворота.

cases.sentence: В ваших сердцах нет любви к ___.
cases.translation: There is no love of God in your hearts.
cases.explain: The preposition к ("toward") requires the dative case.

cases.translation: Get up, take your mat, and walk.
cases.explain: Циновку is the direct object of the transitive verb взять (imperative возьми, "take"), so it takes the accusative case.

cases.translation: The pool was surrounded by five covered colonnades.
cases.explain: The participle окружённый ("surrounded by") governs the instrumental case for the means/agent doing the surrounding.

cases.sentence: Он к тому же называл Бога своим ___.
cases.translation: He also called God his own Father.
cases.explain: The verb называть кого-то кем-то ("to call someone something") requires the predicate noun in the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: ___, недалеко от овечьих ворот, есть пруд.
cases.translation: In Jerusalem, not far from the sheep gate, there is a pool.
cases.explain: The preposition в ("in", location) requires the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Вы посылали к ___, и он свидетельствовал об истине.
cases.translation: You sent to John, and he testified to the truth.
cases.explain: The preposition к ("to") requires the dative case.

reading.ru: Немного позже Иисус пошел на иудейский праздник в Иерусалим.
reading.question: Why did Jesus go up to Jerusalem?
reading.explain: The text says Jesus went up to Jerusalem for a Jewish feast.

reading.ru: Там лежало много инвалидов, слепых, хромых и парализованных.
reading.question: Who was lying at the pool of Bethesda?
options: A great number of sick, blind, lame, and paralyzed people
reading.correct: A great number of sick, blind, lame, and paralyzed people
reading.explain: The text describes many invalids, blind, lame, and paralyzed people lying there.

reading.ru: Среди них был человек, больной уже 38 лет.
reading.question: How long had the sick man been ill?
reading.explain: The text states the man had been sick for 38 years.

reading.ru: Тогда Иисус сказал ему, «Встань, возьми свою циновку и иди».
reading.question: What did Jesus tell the sick man to do?
options: Stand up, take his mat, and walk
Wash in the pool seven times
Go show himself to the priest
reading.correct: Stand up, take his mat, and walk
reading.explain: Jesus told him, "Get up, take your mat and walk."

reading.ru: Иудеи поэтому сказали исцеленному, «Сегодня суббота, и тебе нельзя нести циновку».
reading.question: Why did the Jews object to the healed man carrying his mat?
options: Because it was the Sabbath, and carrying it was not lawful
Because he had stolen the mat
reading.correct: Because it was the Sabbath, and carrying it was not lawful
reading.explain: The Jews said it was the Sabbath and it was not lawful to carry the mat.

reading.ru: Иисус же сказал им, «Мой Отец совершает работу всегда, и я тоже это делаю».
reading.question: How did Jesus justify working on the Sabbath?
options: He said his Father is always working, so he works too
He said the Sabbath law did not apply to him
He said the sick man asked him to
He said the Pharisees gave him permission
reading.correct: He said his Father is always working, so he works too
reading.explain: Jesus answered that his Father is always working, and so he works too.

reading.ru: Точно так, как отец воскрешает мертвых и дает им жизнь, так и сын дает жизнь тем, кому хочет.
reading.question: According to Jesus, what does the Son do, just as the Father does?
options: Raises the dead and gives life to whomever he wishes
reading.correct: Raises the dead and gives life to whomever he wishes
reading.explain: Jesus says just as the Father raises the dead and gives life, so the Son gives life to whom he wishes.

reading.ru: Наступает время, и уже наступило, когда мертвые услышат голос Сына Божьего, и те, кто услышат, оживут».
reading.question: What will happen when the dead hear the voice of the Son of God?
options: They will remain in the grave
reading.explain: The text says those who hear the voice of the Son of God will live.

reading.ru: Вы посылали к Иоанну, и он свидетельствовал об истине.
reading.question: Whom does Jesus mention as a witness the Jews had sent to?
reading.explain: Jesus reminds them that they sent to John, and he testified to the truth.

reading.ru: Вы старательно исследуете Писания, надеясь через них получить жизнь вечную. А ведь эти Писания свидетельствуют обо мне.
reading.question: What does Jesus say the Scriptures do?
options: They are irrelevant to eternal life
reading.explain: Jesus says the Scriptures they search testify about him.

reading.ru: Если бы вы верили Моисею, то верили бы и мне, потому что Моисей писал обо мне.
reading.question: According to Jesus, who wrote about him?
reading.explain: Jesus says Moses wrote about him, so believing Moses should lead to believing Jesus.
